diagnosis.title: Service connection secret expired or invalid (Entra ID)
diagnosis.why: The Azure service connection uses an app registration secret that expired or is wrong. Every pipeline using that connection fails at login.
fix: A pipeline admin should convert the service connection to **workload identity federation** (no secret to expire) - Project settings > Service connections > Convert.
Short-term: rotate the secret on the app registration and update the connection.
Add an expiry alert for remaining secret-based connections.

diagnosis.title: npm peer-dependency conflict (ERESOLVE)
diagnosis.why: Two packages require incompatible versions of a shared peer dependency. Usually introduced by a version bump in package.json.
fix: Read the 'Could not resolve dependency' / 'peer X from Y' lines to find the two conflicting packages.
Align versions (upgrade the package that needs the newer peer, or pin the older one) and regenerate package-lock.json with `npm install`.
Use `--legacy-peer-deps` only as a temporary, documented workaround.
